definition.name: Battlecraft
definition.description: A master of arms who turns discipline and technique into his greatest strength. Every blow is calculated to break the enemy defense, exploit their weak points, and set up a devastating finisher. His combat is precise, methodical, and lethal, rewarding those who master the rhythm of battle.

mastery.name: Master Armorer
mastery.description: While wielding a two-handed weapon, all damage you deal is increased by 10%.

definition.name: Bloodrush
definition.description: A berserker who fights with a weapon in each hand and lets rage drive his every move. The longer he fights, the greater his Enrage, unleashing a relentless storm of attacks that gives his enemies no respite. A frenzied, savage, aggressive style where the offensive never stops. Committing to Bloodrush unlocks dual wielding, and through Titan's Grip even a two-handed weapon in each hand.

mastery.name: Bloodletter
mastery.description: Increases your critical strike chance by 5% and attack power by 10.

definition.name: Bristly Boar Hides
definition.text: Boar hide makes the finest travel packs, and the meadows west of town are crawling with the beasts. Bring me 5 Bristly Boar Hides and I will make it worth your time.
definition.completionText: Ah, fine bristly hides! These will fetch a good price.

definition.name: Wolves at the Door
definition.text: The forest wolves grow bold, snapping at travelers on the north road. Thin their numbers, $N. Slay 8 Forest Wolves and Eastbrook will breathe easier.
definition.completionText: Fine work. The road feels safer already.

definition.name: Bursar Aldous Crane
definition.title: The Gilded Strongbox
definition.greeting: Every crate, coffer, and trinket is safe with the Gilded Strongbox.

definition.name: Bursar Fernando
definition.title: The Gilded Strongbox
definition.greeting: Welcome to the Gilded Strongbox. Your goods rest safe behind our locks.

definition.name: Bursar Petra Vell
definition.title: The Gilded Strongbox
definition.greeting: The Gilded Strongbox keeps clean ledgers and cleaner vaults. What shall we stow for you?

definition.name: Marshal Redbrook
definition.title: Town Marshal
definition.greeting: Keep your blade close, $C. The Vale is not what it was.

definition.name: The Merchant
definition.title: Keeper of the World Market
definition.greeting: Welcome to the World Market, $C. Buy from every adventurer in the realm — or set out your own wares and let coin find you.

definition.name: Trader Wilkes
definition.title: Provisioner
definition.greeting: Fresh bread, clean water, fair prices. What can I get you?

definition.name: Die by the Sword
definition.description: Defensive cooldown: for 8 sec you take 30% less damage and dodge far more attacks.

definition.name: Double Charge
definition.description: Your Charge stores 2 uses, so you can charge twice in a row.

definition.name: Victory Rush
definition.description: Grants Victory Rush: after killing an enemy, your next strike heals you for 20% of your maximum health.

definition.name: Bloodletting
definition.description: Instantly attack in a blood frenzy for $d, healing you for 3% of your maximum health and generating 12 rage. Has a 30% chance to Enrage you. (Fury signature)

definition.name: Maiming Strike
definition.description: A vicious strike dealing weapon damage plus $d and reducing healing the target receives by 50% for 10 sec. Applies Gaping Wounds (bleed). (Arms signature)

definition.name: Redhand
definition.description: Instant attack (2 charges) for weapon damage plus $d that empowers your next Maiming Strike by 20% (stacks twice). Cannot be dodged.
